data: Which algorithms are evaluated in the figure?

The figure shows two graphs comparing different algorithms across various metrics. The left graph compares the percentage of images of gender anti-stereotypical people in summaries across different algorithms, while the right graph compares accuracy across different algorithms. The algorithms being evaluated are:

1. QS-balanced (this paper)
2. MMR
3. AUTOLABEL
4. AUTOLABEL-RWD
5. MMR-balanced (this paper)

These algorithms are represented by different colored lines in both graphs.
